title: SCEP
description: Has the device request a certificate from a SCEP server, so the private key never leaves the device.

PayloadContent.title: Payload content
PayloadContent.description: A dictionary containing the SCEP information.

AllowAllAppsAccess.title: Allow all apps access
AllowAllAppsAccess.description: If true, all apps have access to the private key.

CAFingerprint.title: Fingerprint
CAFingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the Certificate Authority certificate.

Key Usage.title: Key usage
Key Usage.description:
A bitmask indicating the use of the key. Possible values:

- 1: Signing
- 4: Encryption

Some certificate authorities, such as Windows CA, support only encryption or signing, but not both at the same time.

KeyIsExtractable.title: Key is extractable
KeyIsExtractable.description: If false, the system disables exporting the private key from the keychain.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: A string that's understood by the SCEP server; for example, a domain name like example.org. If a certificate authority has multiple CA certificates, use this field to distinguish which is required.

Retries.title: Retries
Retries.description: The number of times the device should retry if the server sends a PENDING response.

RetryDelay.title: Retry delay
RetryDelay.description: The number of seconds to wait between subsequent retries. The device attempts the first retry without this delay.

Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description:
The representation of an X.500 name as an array of OID and value.

For example, /C=US/O=Apple Inc./CN=foo/1.2.5.3=bar translates to [ [ ["C", "US"] ], [ ["O", "Apple Inc."] ], …, [ [ "1.2.5.3", "bar" ] ] ].

You can represent OIDs as dotted numbers, with shortcuts for country (C), locality (L), state (ST), organization (O), organizational unit (OU), and common name (CN).

SubjectAltName.title: Subject alt name
SubjectAltName.description: The SCEP payload can specify an optional SubjectAltName dictionary that provides values required by the CA for issuing a certificate. You can specify a single string or an array of strings for each key. The values you specify depend on the CA you're using, but might include DNS name, URL, or email values. For an example, see Sample Configuration Profile or Over-the-Air Profile Delivery and Configuration.

ntPrincipalName.title: NT principal name
ntPrincipalName.description: The NT principal name. Use an other name OID set to 1.3.6.1.4.1.311.20.2.3.

URL.title: URL
URL.description: The SCEP URL. See Over-the-Air Profile Delivery and Configuration for more information about SCEP.
